items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: George McCullough, that's Alvin's stepbrother. Yeah I know him.

ctx.x: You hear the way to get over that alto you'd wonder why you'd never play some clarinet anyhow.

I was getting back to the bands. I played with a couple of little small bands, you know what I mean, of course it's not too much but the people say when you make a gig and make a little money or something. Yeah. Yeah. See that was my off time when I wouldn't be doing nothing or traveling like that but I'd take a little job out of town. When I played with an Italian fella in Homer he had a band out there and they sent for me. I went out there, I stayed a couple of weeks out there with him. That's when Alvin…
We meet him when we go over the lake. On the course we catch up.
